title: Constrain database, collection and free-text tool argument schemas
description: In the same checkout, constrain the database-bound identifiers and free-text arguments: in src/tools/mongodb/mongodbTool.ts (lines 11-17) replace the unbounded z.string() database and collection fields with the bounded shared string primitive plus a MongoDB identifier pattern and maxLength; bound exportTitle in src/tools/mongodb/read/export.ts (line 16) and the assistant search query in src/tools/assistant/searchKnowledge.ts (lines 9-14), reusing the task 1 primitives rather than ad-hoc limits. Keep the tool schema describe() texts intact for MCP clients. Constraints: the vitest gate is blocking; no deployment windows or change freeze are configured in sdlc/policy.json, so only the dev -> qa -> prod environmentsOrder applies.
acceptanceCriteria: src/tools/mongodb/mongodbTool.ts database and collection fields enforce a MongoDB identifier pattern with a maxLength and reject values containing spaces or $
exportTitle in src/tools/mongodb/read/export.ts and the query argument in src/tools/assistant/searchKnowledge.ts enforce a maxLength
A vitest case rejects a find with database name 'a b$' and a 5,000-character exportTitle while a valid normal-length call still passes, and the vitest run exits 0

verificationMethod.description: Reviewer inspects the diffs of src/tools/mongodb/mongodbTool.ts, src/tools/mongodb/read/export.ts and src/tools/assistant/searchKnowledge.ts with the vitest output: expected result - every database-bound string argument is a bounded, pattern-constrained schema and the suite passes.

rootCause.description: Per-tool schemas reused plain unbounded z.string() for database and collection names and free-text arguments, so no identifier pattern or size limit was enforced before values reached the MongoDB driver.
